trackerLog.subject: Framefield
trackerLog.note: Committed feature sets through 2.0. Order: 1.0 Field core, 1.1 Chrome, 1.2 Transform/inspector values, 1.3 Import, 1.4 Navigation, 1.5 Nested spaces, 1.6 Layers, 2.0a Presence, 2.0b Style card, 2.0c Grok draws. Do not start the next set until the previous exit is true. BUG-001 and BUG-002 gate 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, and 2.0c.
trackerLog.decision: Feature sets SET-1.0 through SET-2.0c are the logged plan leading up to 2.0. Phases 3, 4, and 5 stay after 2.0.

set.title: Field core
set.intent: One editor boards a short sequence on a single square.
set.exit: Draw at default zoom, reload, export. Geometry survives.
set.include: Select, hand, frame, pen, shape, text, arrow
One sequence rail, layer default in data

set.title: Chrome and contracts
set.intent: The shell will not be renamed at 2.0.
set.exit: Select a frame. Inspector says it is selected. Hidden docks exist. Flags flip without a layout rewrite.
set.include: Named regions, tokens, data-ui / data-flag / data-node
Docks for Grok, presence, layers, style mounted and hidden
Dev mode on; flag panel with descriptions
FEAT-020 inspector shell, empty property rows

set.title: Selection, transform, professional inspector values
set.intent: The user can change what they drew, in world units, at any zoom.
set.exit: Zoom in, draw, select, nudge in the inspector, undo. Field matches numbers.
set.include: Inspector values: type, name, x, y, rotation, scale, lock, hide, layerId read-only default, order read-only
Undo/redo for create, delete, transform, props

set.title: Bring work in
set.intent: Planning does not start from a blank field.
set.exit: Drop SVG or DXF, crop, place in a frame, export. Y-up flipped only at screen.
set.include: DWG stub or converter — do not block on DWG license

set.title: Navigation and board literacy
set.intent: A larger board stays findable without nested spaces yet.
set.exit: A twelve-frame row can be flown, fitted, and found from the rail and palette.
set.include: Command palette; later verbs registered and disabled
First-run: blank / import / Ask Grok disabled

set.title: Nested spaces, no max zoom
set.intent: Unbounded zoom without a single global scale.
set.exit: Draw in a child, zoom out, return via origin mark. Parent objects did not move.
set.include: Enter parent or insert parent at Sout
Hysteresis; checkerboard + origin while flags on
Dev panel: space, camera, ulp; product-to-root display only

set.title: Layer data and panel (pre-Grok)
set.intent: Stacking is editable before a model writes objects.
set.exit: Two layers, hide one, move a frame. Camera unchanged. Draw still matches ghost.
set.include: Create, rename, hide, lock, reorder, opacity
Move selection between layers changes layerId+order only
System bands reserved: guides, ghosts, comments, presence

set.title: Presence
set.intent: See others without letting them write.
set.exit: A second signed-in viewer can be seen and dimmed.

set.title: Style card
set.intent: Project style exists before the model uses it.
set.exit: A frame knows its aspect and pins without calling a model.

set.title: Grok draws
set.intent: A paragraph becomes an editable sequence of frames.
set.exit: Labeled sequence of frames the user can still edit.
